name: PRIME viral mutation-space evaluation
description: Evaluation framework for protein representations on SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding-domain mutants: ACE2 binding and expression regression under a random split and a position-stratified split that holds out mutated positions.

attributes.task: Predict RBD mutant binding and expression from protein language model representations
attributes.scope_note: The position-stratified split holds out whole mutated positions, so it measures generalisation to unseen positions rather than unseen mutants.
attributes.source_locator: Table 1 and its surrounding Results text
limitations: One protein (SARS-CoV-2 RBD) and two phenotypes; results do not transfer to other proteins without further evidence.
Author-reported: the PRIME authors ran every model and also contribute the fine-tuned ESM-RBD variants, which are the best-scoring rows.
